page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, set in italic, lines alternately indented. Running head at the top with the page number at the left. No notes in the margins. Faint show-through from the reverse side at the right margin, not transcribed.

p.i: Uani cernit opem rebus in asperis.
Si quis vina putat carpere, fallitur.
Non plus dente nocet Vipera sontico[?].

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "sontico" (line 22) is unclear; the first letter may be f. "Vvas" and "Vvis" are printed with u-shaped V forms; rendered as consonantal v per the spelling rules. The ct ligature in "cuncta" and "fructus" is resolved to plain letters. The circular stamp in the right margin and the show-through from the other side are omitted. The page ends mid-poem, so no catchword is given.
